Profile Descriptions:

  • allocs:
    A sampling of all past memory allocations
  • block:
    Stack traces that led to blocking on synchronization primitives
  • cmdline:
    The command line invocation of the current program
  • goroutine:
    Stack traces of all current goroutines. Use debug=2 as a query parameter to export in the same format as an unrecovered panic.
  • heap:
    A sampling of memory allocations of live objects. You can specify the gc GET parameter to run GC before taking the heap sample.
  • mutex:
    Stack traces of holders of contended mutexes
  • profile:
    CPU profile. You can specify the duration in the seconds GET parameter. After you get the profile file, use the go tool pprof command to investigate the profile.
  • threadcreate:
    Stack traces that led to the creation of new OS threads
  • trace:
    A trace of execution of the current program. You can specify the duration in the seconds GET parameter. After you get the trace file, use the go tool trace command to investigate the trace.

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set IS_COPY=%1



cd %SCRIPT_DIR%
echo %cd%
@REM 编译前端代码
echo -------build frontend app begin----------
python build_nmtool_web/build_nmtool_web.py

if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool_web failed"
  exit 1
)
echo -------build frontend app end------------

REM 打包后端
ECHO cum_cm_service
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
call %SCRIPT_DIR%build_unm_cm_service.bat
if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool failed,build_unm_cm_service.bat error"
  exit 1
)

IF "%IS_COPY%" == "true" (
 GOTO COPY
) ELSE (
 GOTO END
)
:COPY
call %SCRIPT_DIR%copy_to_unm2000.bat
call %SCRIPT_DIR%make_nmtool_src.bat
GOTO END
:END

REM 删除相关文件
cd %SCRIPT_DIR%..
if EXIST temp.zip (
call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
IF EXIST build_temp_dir (
	
  call %WINRAR% a -ep1 -r -df temp.zip build_temp_dir
  call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
echo success

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

#current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f $"0"))
#thirdparty_path=$(dirname $(dirname $current_path))/thirdparty
#定时任务是通过cron.service文件执行的，当前目录变更为根目录了，所以这里采取在安装nginx的时候记录nginx的路径
nginx_home=$(cat /usr/nginx_home)
days=7
LOGS_PATH=$nginx_home/logs
 
NEWLOGS_PATH=$LOGS_PATH/history

if [ ! -d "$NEWLOGS_PATH" ];then
	mkdir $NEWLOGS_PATH
fi
 
YESTERDAY=$(date -d "yesterday" +%Y%m%d)
 

mv ${LOGS_PATH}/access.log ${NEWLOGS_PATH}/access_${YESTERDAY}.log
 
/bin/kill -SIGUSR1 $(cat $nginx_home/nginx.pid)

find $NEWLOGS_PATH/ -mtime +$days -delete

record.rsp_body:
@echo off
call %~dp0\set.bat
call "%~dp0..\Service\check_admin_right.bat"
set PYTHONHOME=%UnmInstallPath%\ext\tool\python27
set PATH=%PYTHONHOME%;%PYTHONHOME%\Scripts;%PATH%

rem 清除文件只读
attrib %UnmInstallPath%\* -r /s 

rem 执行安装前执行
call %~dp0\delService.bat
call %~dp0\installClient.bat

call "%~dp0..\..\..\script\log_for_kill_process.bat" caller "%~0"


REM 调用卸载服务操作
rem 安装服务脚本不再调用卸载服务脚本，由开发统一调配
rem call "%~dp0\uninstallservice.bat"

set CONFIG_DIR=%UnmInstallPath%\server\etc\ice\defaultgrid
Set iceGridAdmin=%UnmInstallPath%\ext\bin\icegridadmin.exe
REM 清除中间目录并重建
set iceDefDb=%UnmInstallPath%\server\etc\ice\defaultgrid\db
set iceDefDbNode=%UnmInstallPath%\server\etc\ice\defaultgrid\db\node
if exist %iceDefDb% (rd /s /q %iceDefDb%)
if not exist %iceDefDb% md %iceDefDb%
if not exist %iceDefDbNode% md %iceDefDbNode%

REM 设置环境变量
echo Settings environment variable
call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\env_set.bat

rem 调用数据库提供的脚本。
if exist %UnmInstallPath%\tools\server\tool\MTScript\installmtscripy.bat call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\server\tool\MTScript\installmtscripy.bat

REM 刷新配置数据并注册服务
echo Refresh the configration data and register the service
if exist %~dp0\UpdateConfigFile.bat call %~dp0\UpdateConfigFile.bat
REM 注册临时license
echo Register temporary license
if exist %~dp0runset.bat call %~dp0runset.bat
echo Registation nmtool,sidecar and other services
call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\before_installservice.bat

REM 注册双因子服务
echo Sign authserver servuce.
if exist %UnmInstallPath%\platform\jar\authserver\bin\install_authserver.bat (
	call %UnmInstallPath%\platform\jar\authserver\bin\install_authserver.bat
)

REM 调用export安装脚本。
echo Call the export installation Script.
if exist %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\InstallUnmExport.bat (
cmd /c call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\InstallUnmExport.bat
)

if "%architecture%"=="2" (

REM 重新注册服务并启动IceRegistry
echo Re-register the service and start the service
cmd /c call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\InstallModeService.bat
if %DeployMode% GEQ 1 if %DeployMode% LEQ 2 (
:WAIT_REGISTRY1
ping localhost -n 3 >>NUL

net start "icegridregistry.UnmBusIceGrid"
if  "2"=="%errorlevel%" goto WAIT_REGISTRY
if not "0"=="%errorlevel%" goto WAIT_REGISTRY1

:WAIT_REGISTRY
ping localhost -n 3 >>NUL

REM  注册服务
REM for /f "tokens=1 delims=^|" %%i in (%UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\Service\unm2000_node.lst) do (
REM ping localhost -n 1 >>NUL
REM %iceGridAdmin% --Ice.Config=%CONFIG_DIR%/%%i -u=root -p=unm2000 -e "application add -n '%CONFIG_DIR%/application.xml'"

REM %iceGridAdmin% --Ice.Config=%CONFIG_DIR%/%%i -u=root -p=unm2000 -e "application update '%CONFIG_DIR%/application.xml'"
REM )

for /f "tokens=2 delims=^|" %%i in (%UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\Service\unm2000_node.lst) do (
sc config "%%i" start=delayed-auto
ping localhost -n 1 >>NUL
)


echo icegridadmin err=%errorlevel%
if not "0"=="%errorlevel%" goto WAIT_REGISTRY

echo .
echo ICE application has been started:

echo .
echo icegrid service environment is ready.
)
)


if "%architecture%"=="1" (
REM 添加UnmCusaServiceMonitor服务，
if %DeployMode% GEQ 1 if %DeployMode% LEQ 2 (
if exist %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\CusaServiceMonitorInstsrv.bat call %UnmInstallPath%\tools\configedit\CusaServiceMonitorInstsrv.bat 
)
)


ping localhost -n 2 >>NUL

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=`dirname $0`
SERVICE=nmtool_cm_agent
cmagentPath=$UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent
systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	echo "${SERVICE}is runing, please check and stop it before install"
	exit 0
fi

ROOT_DIR=`pwd`
data=`gcc -v 2>&1`
if [[ $data =~ "gcc version" ]]||[[ $data =~ "gcc 版本" ]]
then
  echo 安装了gcc
else 
  echo 没有安装gcc,自动安装gcc
  #rpm -Uvh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/tools/gcc/*.rpm --nodeps --force 
fi
#source ${UNM_ROOT}/server/tool/unmvars.sh
$UNM_ROOT/server/tool/Python27/python -m pip install --no-index --find-links=$UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/packages -r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/requirements-linux.txt

#unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH
#chmod 777 cmagentstart.server
#chmod 777 nmtool_cm_agent.service

startType="0"
if [ ! -f $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini ];
then
	echo not exit unm2000install.ini file
else
    startType=$(cat $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini | grep startType | awk -F '=' '{print $2}')
fi
if [[ $startType -eq "1" ]]
then
        sudo chmod u+r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		sudo cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/cmagentstart.server /etc/init.d/
		sudo cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent-user.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/nmtool_cm_agent.service
	
        sudo systemctl enable nmtool_cm_agent
        sudo systemctl daemon-reload
		if [ ! -d $cmagentPath/temp ];then
			mkdir $cmagentPath/temp
		fi
else
		chmod u+r $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/cmagentstart.server /etc/init.d/
		cp $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/nmtool_cm_agent.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/nmtool_cm_agent.service
		systemctl enable $SERVICE
        systemctl daemon-reload
fi

@echo off

set server_ip=%1
set server_user=%2
set server_pwd=%3
set install_path=%4
set cusaplatform_user_dir=%5
set upload_folder=%6
set cusaplatform_root_path=%~d0
set cusaagent_folder=CusaDeployAgent
set start_bat_path=%install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%\service\start.bat

echo "cusaplatform_root_path is: " %cusaplatform_root_path%
echo "cusaplatform_user_dir is: " %cusaplatform_user_dir%
echo "start_bat_path is: " %start_bat_path%

cd /d %~dp0
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform	hirdparty
set local_folder=%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\%upload_folder%
:: set remote_folder= .170.90.218\D$\CusaDeployAgent
set remote_folder=\%server_ip%\%install_path%$\%cusaagent_folder%
echo "local_folder path: " %local_folder%
echo "remote_folder path: " %remote_folder%
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform\log
set log_file_path=%cusaplatform_user_dir%\log
echo %cd%
echo "-----set args finished!-----"

:: if exist %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log del %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log /f /s /q /a
if exist %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log del /F /S /Q %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log

if not exist %local_folder% (
    echo "error: %local_folder% not exist"
    echo "%local_folder% not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ /delete
ping %server_ip% -n 10 >nul
net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail"
    echo "error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail: ">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%>>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log 2>&1
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----connect successed!-----"

if exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "%remote_folder% is exist, delete %remote_folder%"
    rd /S /Q %remote_folder%
    ping %server_ip% -n 10 >nul
)

xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I is fail"
    echo "xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
if not exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "error: %remote_folder% is not exist"
    echo "%remote_folder% is not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
echo "-----xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% finished!-----"


if exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip% (
    rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
) else (
    md %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
)
CALL %local_folder%\service\create-cusaagentxml.bat %server_ip% %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%
if not exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml (
    echo "error: create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail"
    echo "create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

if exist %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml del /S /Q %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml /f /s /q /a

copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y is fail"
    echo "copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%

net use \%server_ip% /delete
echo "-----delete connect successed!-----"

@echo "-----install cusaagent successed!
exit /b 0

:ERROREXIT
exit /b 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# This script prints the release version for emqx

# ensure dir
cd -P -- "$(dirname -- "$0")"

if [ -f EMQX_ENTERPRISE ]; then
    EDITION='enterprise'
else
    EDITION='opensource'
fi

## emqx_release.hrl is the single source of truth for release version
RELEASE="$(grep -E "define.+EMQX_RELEASE.+${EDITION}" include/emqx_release.hrl | cut -d '"' -f2)"

git_exact_vsn() {
    local tag
    tag="$(git describe --tags --match "[e|v]*" --exact 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "${tag#[e|v]}"
}

GIT_EXACT_VSN="$(git_exact_vsn)"
if [ "$GIT_EXACT_VSN" != '' ]; then
    if [ "$GIT_EXACT_VSN" != "$RELEASE" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Tagged $GIT_EXACT_VSN, but $RELEASE in include/emqx_release.hrl" 1>&2
        exit 1
    fi
    SUFFIX=''
else
    SUFFIX="-$(git rev-parse HEAD | cut -b1-8)"
fi

echo "${RELEASE}${SUFFIX}"

#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set IS_COPY=%1



cd %SCRIPT_DIR%
echo %cd%
@REM 编译前端代码
echo -------build frontend app begin----------
python build_nmtool_web/build_nmtool_web.py

if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool_web failed"
  exit 1
)
echo -------build frontend app end------------

REM 打包后端
ECHO cum_cm_service
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
call %SCRIPT_DIR%build_unm_cm_service.bat
if not %errorlevel% == 0 (
  echo "build nmtool failed,build_unm_cm_service.bat error"
  exit 1
)

IF "%IS_COPY%" == "true" (
 GOTO COPY
) ELSE (
 GOTO END
)
:COPY
call %SCRIPT_DIR%copy_to_unm2000.bat
call %SCRIPT_DIR%make_nmtool_src.bat
GOTO END
:END

REM 删除相关文件
cd %SCRIPT_DIR%..
if EXIST temp.zip (
call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
IF EXIST build_temp_dir (
	
  call %WINRAR% a -ep1 -r -df temp.zip build_temp_dir
  call del/s/q/f temp.zip
)
call "%SCRIPT_DIR%clean_build_unm_cm_service.bat"
echo success

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#! /bin/bash

main(){
systemctl stop firewalld
systemctl disable firewalld
curl=`curl --version 2> /dev/null`
wget=`wget --version 2> /dev/null`
if [ "${curl#*"curl"}" != "$curl" ]; then
       downloader="curl"
elif [ "${wget#*"Wget"}" != "$wget" ]; then
       downloader="wget"
else
       echo "Please instll curl or wget"
       exit 1
fi

vscp_dir="/usr/local/vscp"
if [ ! -f "$vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh" ];then
       sh $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh
fi
sleep  1
if [ ! -d "$vscp_dir" ];then
       mkdir $vscp_dir
fi

if [ "$downloader"=="curl" ];then
	 curl -o $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
else
	 wget -O $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
fi

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
$vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client 10.190.160.90:8848 > $vscp_dir/run.log &" > $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
systemctl stop vscp
rm -f /usr/lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -f /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -rf /usr/local/vscp
systemctl daemon-reload" > $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh

echo -e "[Unit]
Description=vscp client
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=forking
ExecStart=/bin/bash -c $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh
ExecReload=
ExecStop=/bin/bash -c  ps -ef|grep k8s-vm-client |grep -v grep |awk '{print \$2}'

PrivateTmp=True

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target" > /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service

chmod -R 777 $vscp_dir

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable vscp
systemctl start vscp

}
main

echo %origin_folder%
cd ..
set parent_folder=%cd%
echo parent_folder%parent_folder%
set tool_folder=%parent_folder%\dev_tools
echo tool_folder%tool_folder%
if not exist %node_path% (
	echo remove dir %node_path%
	rd /s /q %node_path%
	call WinRAR.exe X %tool_folder%\%node_file_pre%.zip %node_parent%
)

cd %origin_folder%

::---------------------------check ng-----------------------------------
:ng
call where ng
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		:ngOK
		echo "-----ng is already installed-----"
		call ng version
	) else (
		:: config npm registry
		echo "-----set npm registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm -----"
		call npm config set registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm

		cd %node_path%

	::---------------------------install ng-----------------------------------
		echo "-----install @angular/cli@8.1.0... -----"
		call npm install @angular/cli@8.1.0
		if !errorlevel!==0 (
			call ng version
		) else (
			@echo "-----global install ng cli failed! -----"
			goto end
		)
	)
::--- add --max_old_space_size=4096 to ng.cmd
call xcopy %tool_folder%
g.cmd %node_path% /H /K /R /Y

::---------------------------check waf-----------------------------------
:waf
call where waf
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		:wafOK
		echo "-----waf is already installed-----"
		call waf --version
	) else (
	::---------------------------install waf-----------------------------------
		:: set node-sass binary path just for this bat
		echo parent_folder=%parent_folder%
		set SASS_BINARY_PATH=%tool_folder%\win32-x64-64_binding.node
		echo "SASS_BINARY_PATH:" !SASS_BINARY_PATH!
		:: config npm registry
		echo "-----set npm registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm -----"
		call npm config set registry http://prdrepo.fiberhome.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm

		cd %node_path%

		echo "-----install waf... -----"
		call npm install @waf_cli/cli

		if !errorlevel!==0 (
			call waf --version
		) else (
			echo "-----install waf cli failed! -----"
			goto end
		)
	)

:: ---------------------------check npm 3.10.10--------------------------------------
for /F %%i in ('npm -v')do set npm_version=%%i
echo npm_version=!npm_version!
if !npm_version!==3.10.10 (
	call npm -v
) else (
    echo "-----npm version is not avalable!-----"
	echo "-----replace npm@!npm_version! with npm@3.10.10 -----"
	if exist %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip del %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip
	xcopy %tool_folder%
pm@3.10.10.zip	 %node_path%
ode_modules\n	rd %node_path%
ode_modules
pm /S /Q
	call WinRAR.exe X %node_path%
ode_modules
pm@3.10.10.zip %node_path%
ode_modules
	if !errorlevel!==0 (
		echo "-----npm@3.10.10 is already installed! current version:-----"
		call npm -v
	) else (
		echo "-----install npm@3.10.10 failed! -----"
		goto end
	)
)

cd %origin_folder%
call build-2.bat %node_file_pre%
:end
echo "-----end pre-build.bat-----"

#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=()

openEuler_RPM_spec=()

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#!/bin/bash -x

# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

# Android kernel
## Compilation
The Android kernel source code is located in the `BST-C1200-LINUX-SDK-Vx.x.x.x-Release/opensource_code` directory as `kernel_android_xxxxxxxxx.tar.gz`. Refer to the [SDK installation](../../quickstart_en/sdk_userguide/sdk-install.md) section for instructions on installing container image dependencies. After setting up the FDK, DDK, and SDK container development environment, copy the source code archive into the container and execute the following commands to compile:

```shell
source /opt/bstos/linux-25/environment-setup-aarch64-bst-linux
./make_c1200_android.sh
```

The generated image, dtb, and defconfig files are located at:

```shell
build/arch/arm64/boot/Image
build/arch/arm64/boot/dts/bst/bstc1200-ivi.dtb
arch/arm64/configs/bstc1200_ivi_defconfig
```

**Note: The image generated here is only the Android kernel image. To generate a complete IVI system image, you need to download the Android code from the developer website and copy the three generated files to the corresponding locations in the Android code project for image compilation.**

# Android kernel
## Compilation
The Android kernel source code is located in the `BST-C1200-LINUX-SDK-Vx.x.x.x-Release/opensource_code` directory as `kernel_android_xxxxxxxxx.tar.gz`. Refer to the [SDK installation](../../quickstart_en/sdk_userguide/sdk-install.md) section for instructions on installing container image dependencies. After setting up the FDK, DDK, and SDK container development environment, copy the source code archive into the container and execute the following commands to compile:

```shell
source /opt/bstos/linux-25/environment-setup-aarch64-bst-linux
./make_c1200_android.sh
```

The generated image, dtb, and defconfig files are located at:

```shell
build/arch/arm64/boot/Image
build/arch/arm64/boot/dts/bst/bstc1200-ivi.dtb
arch/arm64/configs/bstc1200_ivi_defconfig
```

**Note: The image generated here is only the Android kernel image. To generate a complete IVI system image, you need to download the Android code from the developer website and copy the three generated files to the corresponding locations in the Android code project for image compilation.**

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=('python3_oslo_config' \n'python-cipherclient' \n'python-licenseclient' \n'python-monitorclient' \n'python-serviceclient' \n'update' \n'python3_oslo_messaging')

openEuler_RPM_spec=('recipes-base/python-oslo-config/euler/python3-oslo-config.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-cipherclient/euler/cipherclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/licenseclient/euler/licenseclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/python-monitorclient/euler/monitorclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/serviceclient/euler/serviceclient.spec' \n'recipes-fitos/cgcs-patch/euler/cgcs-patch.spec' \n'recipes-base/python-oslo-messaging/euler/python3-oslo-messaging.spec')

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#Clean up rpmbuild/
ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
exit
eeooff

#Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
    do
        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
    done

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

#build openEuler RPMs
ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
set -o errexit
cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
rpmbuild -ba *
set +o errexit
exit
eeooff
if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
    exit 1
fi

# Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  sleep 5
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
fi

#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
# Copyright 2017 gRPC authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

set -ex

# cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../.."
cd $2

# Install openssl (to use instead of boringssl)
# apt-get update && apt-get install -y libssl-dev
export INSTALL_DIR=$3/install
export OPENSSL_DIR=$6

# 1.46.5 version cannot be compiled by gcc-4.8. by lizhuo
export PATH=/usr/bin:$PATH
export CC=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/gcc
export CXX=$2/gcc-4.9.4/bin/g++
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -fPIC -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections"
export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$2/gcc-4.9.4/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

# Use externally provided env to determine build parallelism, otherwise use default.
# GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS=${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS:-4}

# Install absl
rm -rf "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/abseil-cpp/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install c-ares
rm -rf "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/cares/cares/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCARES_STATIC=ON -DCARES_SHARED=OFF ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install protobuf
rm -rf "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/protobuf/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF ..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install re2
rm -rf "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/re2/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=TRUE ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Install zlib
rm -rf "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
mkdir -p "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
pushd "third_party/zlib/cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
# cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ../..
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# Just before installing gRPC, wipe out contents of all the submodules to simulate
# a standalone build from an archive
# shellcheck disable=SC2016
# git submodule foreach 'cd $toplevel; rm -rf $name'

# Install gRPC
rm -rf "cmake/build"
mkdir -p "cmake/build"
pushd "cmake/build"
cmake -G "$5" \n  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$1 \n  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$INSTALL_DIR \n  -DOPENSSL_ROOT_DIR=$OPENSSL_DIR \n  -DZLIB_ROOT=%INSTALL_DIR% \n  -DgRPC_INSTALL=ON \n  -DgRPC_BUILD_TESTS=OFF \n  -DgRPC_ABSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_CARES_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_PROTOBUF_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_RE2_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_SSL_PROVIDER=package \n  -DgRPC_ZLIB_PROVIDER=package \n  ../..
cmake --build . --config $1 --target install
#make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}" install
popd

# # Build helloworld example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/helloworld
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd

# # Build route_guide example using Makefile and pkg-config
# pushd examples/cpp/route_guide
# export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/grpc/lib/pkgconfig
# export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/grpc/bin
# make "-j${GRPC_CPP_DISTRIBTEST_BUILD_COMPILER_JOBS}"
# popd
